universal_guidelines: Always use data-testid attributes on all interactive and key informational elements.
Do not use transparent background on sticky headers without proper blur scrim.
Ensure high text contrast against background (APCA compliant).
Maintain generous spacing (2-3x normal scale) for luxury editorial whitespace.
